Independent prep school for ages 2–11 in Clapham Junction, London
Independent prep school for ages 2–11 in Clapham Junction, London
Love Wisdom TruthDOLPHIN SCHOOL
In the heart of Northcote Road, Clapham Junction, Dolphin School is a vibrant and truly independent prep school community for boys and girls aged 2–11, where joyful learning is at the very core of everything we do. Rooted in Christian values, we are committed to bringing out the best in every individual, nurturing strong relationships, a firm moral compass and a deep sense of respect. Unashamedly a family school, we work tirelessly within our community to provide a broad, diverse and joyful educational experience — pupils live and breathe a sense of school ownership that binds the Dolphin community in a way that is truly rare and special.
#Something Brilliant
100% parents felt that the school equips their child with the team working, collaborative and research skills they need in later life.
Without a hint of self-importance, pupils develop confidence in their own abilities. They appreciate that whilst their teachers will support and challenge them as they develop and grow, so will their peers.
High expectations of staff and pupils’ own self-discipline enable pupils to make positive transitions within their school and are successful in attaining places in senior schools.
100% of parents believe that the school helps their children develop strong teamwork and social skills.
A BREADTH OF OPPORTUNITY
Life at Dolphin School London is vibrant, varied and filled with opportunities for children to thrive beyond the classroom. From inspiring trips and visits to exciting after-school clubs, we offer a rich and balanced experience that nurtures the whole child.
Life after Dolphin School
Small enough to know every child.Big enough to open every door.Come and see for yourself. Join us for our Dolphin School Open Morning on Thursday 8 October 2026 at 9:15am and experience our extraordinary school in action.Step inside Dolphin and discover a small, nurturing Christian prep school where every child is truly known, valued and encouraged to flourish- academically, creatively, physically and personally.You’ll hear from our Head Teacher, Mrs Lucy Price, and have the opportunity to see our approach to learning first-hand, with our enthusiastic pupils showing you around their school.During your visit, you’ll discover:• Our broad and ambitious curriculum, where strong academic foundations are combined with creativity, curiosity and a love of learning• Our distinctive Christian ethos, rooted in our values of Love, Wisdom and Truth• Learning beyond the classroom, from outdoor learning on nearby Wandsworth Common to trips, visits, clubs and community projects• Our approach to developing confident, curious and kind children, with a strong emphasis on character as well as academic achievement• The Dolphin journey from Nursery to Year 6, and how we prepare our pupils for the next stage of their education and for life beyond the classroom• Our remarkable Year 6 outcomes, with pupils going on to a wide range of leading senior schools, supported by a dedicated and personal approach to senior school choices• Our warm, welcoming community, where strong relationships between children, teachers and families are at the heart of school lifeYou’ll also have the chance to meet and chat with our Senior Team, teachers, current Dolphin parents and, most importantly, our wonderful children...the people who bring Dolphin to life every day.We’d love to welcome you.Book your place today via the Dolphin School website:www.dolphinschool.org.uk📍 Dolphin School, 106 Northcote Road, London SW11 6QW#DolphinSchool #OpenMorning #IndependentSchool #PrepSchool #Battersea ClaphamJunction DiscoverDolphin LoveWisdomTruth
Miss Isla’s Incredible Insights- this week! There’s so much more to discover behind that magnificent smile! 💫This week, we get to know a little more about who Miss Isla is beyond the spotlight, alongside some exciting behind-the-scenes interviews from our most recent sports matches. A glimpse into the personality, passion and wisdom that make her so special…with plenty of fun along the way!Enjoy! Love. Wisdom. Truth.
Where Reading Opens Every DoorAt Dolphin, reading is the bedrock of all learning.The ability to access language is one of the most powerful tools we can give a child: opening up ideas, sparking curiosity and unlocking the knowledge, imagination and possibilities that lie within every area of the curriculum.That journey begins from the very earliest moments. Our strong phonics programme gives children the essential foundations they need to become confident, capable readers, while our classrooms and library are filled with rich, delicious literature that invites children to explore, wonder, question and dream.But reading at Dolphin is about so much more than learning to decode words. It is about discovering new worlds, meeting unforgettable characters, developing empathy and finding the stories that stay with you for a lifetime.We want our children to become fluent readers, thoughtful readers and, most importantly, readers who love to read.Because when a child discovers the joy of a book, they discover that there is always another world waiting to be opened. Small enough to know every child.Big enough to open every door.Love. Wisdom. Truth. #DolphinSchool #ReadingAtDolphin #LoveOfReading #ReadingForPleasure #Phonics Literacy LoveWisdomTruth DiscoverDolphin EveryChildEveryDay

pageCache.pageTitle: Ethos & Aims | Co-educational Prep School | Dolphin School
pageCache.text:
Our Christian ethos is expressed through our foundational values of ‘Love. Wisdom. Truth.’
We believe our unique purpose is to help grow confident, joyful and happy children, ready to thrive.
Love
We strive for every child to be known and loved as an individual, placing relationships and communication at the heart of all we do. Our smaller class sizes support personalised learning and provide abundant opportunities for active participation. In this nurturing environment, pupils grow in confidence and courage; as they learn to value themselves, they also learn to value others through an atmosphere of love and support.
Wisdom
As pupils explore, discover, examine and debate, they deepen their understanding of both the workings and the wonders of the world. Their journey towards wisdom leads them further, towards empathy, respect for differences, and a desire to live with integrity.
Truth
In the microcosm of the classroom, where fairness and dignity shape daily interactions, pupils learn to trust, to be open, and to be themselves. In this atmosphere of safety and respect, they are free to pursue truth: about the world, about others, and about themselves. This freedom encourages risk taking in learning and opens the way to deeper discoveries of Love, Wisdom and Truth.
Our school curriculum is underpinned by the values we hold dear: nurturing every child’s potential in academic study, creative expression and sporting achievement, while also developing their character. Through this curriculum, we aim to equip children with the knowledge, skills and understanding they need to live fulfilling and purposeful lives.

Welcome to Dolphin School—a joyful, nurturing prep school in the heart of Battersea, where children are known, loved and inspired to thrive.
As Headteacher of this vibrant and unique school, I feel a deep sense of privilege to lead a community that so beautifully balances academic excellence with character development. Nestled just off the Northcote Road, Dolphin is a small, co-educational Christian school for children aged 2–11. What sets us apart is our unwavering commitment to educating the whole child—head, heart and hands.
At Dolphin, we live and breathe our core values: Love, Wisdom and Truth. These aren’t just words on a wall—they shape every relationship, lesson and moment of school life. In our small class sizes, every child is truly seen. Our dedicated teachers build meaningful relationships that foster self-belief, resilience and personal growth. This strong foundation allows our pupils to leave Dolphin not just well-prepared academically, but full of empathy, confidence and integrity.
Parents often tell me that Dolphin has that rare quality—a school where rigour and warmth go hand in hand. We expect high standards in learning and behaviour, but we also nurture creativity, curiosity and joy. Whether through science investigations, poetry writing, music-making, outdoor education or problem-solving in maths, our pupils are encouraged to think deeply, act kindly and lead purposefully.
Although we are a Christian school, our community is wonderfully diverse. Families of all faiths and none find a shared sense of purpose in the values we promote: compassion, honesty, service and respect. Our faith underpins a culture of inclusion and integrity—offering children a moral compass to navigate an ever-changing world.
One of the most encouraging pieces of feedback I receive from senior schools is this: “We can always spot a Dolphin pupil.” They are compassionate, grounded and quietly ambitious. They know who they are—and they help others rise, too.
If you are looking for a prep school in London where your child will be truly known, stretched, supported and celebrated, I warmly invite you to come and visit us. Come and see what makes Dolphin different—and why our children leave with not only strong academic results but the character to lead, serve and flourish.
I look forward to welcoming you to Dolphin School soon.
Mrs Lucy Price Headteacher, Dolphin School London

Our Latest Inspection
ISI inspections are rigorous and draw on evidence from governors and school leaders, parents, pupils and staff, alongside lesson observations, pupils’ work and school documentation. This process builds a detailed picture of how a school functions as a whole.
Inspectors found a community working in harmony, with pupils, parents, staff, leadership and governance aligned by shared values and high expectations. Pupils were described as “particularly delightful”, and inspectors noted the warmth and connection with staff that help children to thrive. A strong sense of joy, belonging and care was evident throughout the school.
Relationships sit at the heart of the report. Teachers know pupils well and plan skilfully to meet their needs, creating a safe and purposeful learning environment where children are encouraged to grow in confidence and independence. Parents’ and pupils’ voices strongly reinforced this picture through thoughtful and supportive feedback.
The inspection confirms what the Dolphin community already knows: this is a school where children are known, valued and supported to flourish academically, socially and emotionally in an environment defined by warmth, joy and purpose.

pageCache.pageTitle: Nursery Curriculum | Co-educational School | Dolphin School
pageCache.text:
At Noah’s Ark we deliver the statutory curriculum, the ‘Early Years Foundation Stage’ (EYFS). This curriculum applies to all children between 0 and 5 years in all settings and schools in England and provides a framework on which all Early Years education is based. As well as a Learning and Development component, it also includes Safeguarding and Welfare guidance. The curriculum covers 7 areas of learning, which are split into 2 parts, called the Prime and Specific areas. The Prime areas are considered the key, fundamental areas upon which the Specific areas depend, and together they cover all facets of a child’s development.
There are four themes in the EYFS:
A Unique Child
This theme is about how children develop: they are all different and their learning needs and styles are unique too. Positive relationships and good communication are vital so that we can plan for individual learning needs. Children do best when all their physical and emotional needs are met, and this is what we aim to do at Noah’s Ark. Staff begin by observing each child’s development and learning and assess their progress, planning for their next steps. Together we identify any areas which may need some additional support and arrange this if necessary.
Each child’s development is supported across all the areas of learning by the Characteristics of Effective Learning:
Positive Relationships
This theme is about children learning to manage their feelings and build friendships. We respect all families and aim to develop a positive two-way relationship with parents and carers. Children learn to be strong and independent through positive relationships. Staff are warm and friendly and help to foster a sense of belonging. We are sensitive and responsive to children’s feelings and support their efforts and encourage independence. Children need to learn about risks and safety, how to make right choices, and how to stick to boundaries.
Enabling Environments
This theme is about how we plan for and check on each child’s progress. Children learn and develop well in environments in which the adults provide experiences based on children’s individual needs and there is a strong partnership between staff and parents/carers. These environments value everyone’s learning and offer stimulating resources relevant to all the children’s cultures and communities. We offer rich learning opportunities through play and playful teaching and support children to take risks and to explore.
Learning and Development
This theme is about how children develop and learn in different ways. The EYFS framework covers the education and care of all children in the nursery, including children with additional needs. We teach children by providing challenging, playful opportunities across the Prime and Specific areas of learning and development. We aim to foster the Characteristics of Effective Learning: Playing and Exploring, Active Learning and Creating and Thinking Critically.
The EYFS is divided into two areas. The first, the Prime Areas, begin to develop quickly in response to relationships and experiences, and run through and support learning in all other areas. The Prime areas continue to be essential throughout the whole EYFS.
The Specific Areas include essential skills and knowledge for children to participate successfully in society. They grow out of the Prime areas and provide important contexts for learning.
Literacy: Reading, Writing.
Mathematics: Numbers, Shape, space and measure.
A Range Of Opportunities
Activities from all the above curricular areas are planned on a daily and weekly basis, taking into account the child’s previous learning, and are extended to accommodate the needs of individual children. Staff intervene where appropriate to enhance this learning through play experience. Teachers take notes during observation of the children at work and play and this information informs future planning.
We recognise that all children have unique skills and achieve differently and that it is inappropriate to make provision for them in a uniform way. We concentrate on providing a range of learning opportunities in order to meet each child’s learning needs.
Children work through a series of development steps towards the early learning goals which most children will reach by the end of their Reception Year. Throughout their time at Noah’s Ark, each teacher keeps a record of each child through an online programme, Tapestry, where their progress and development is monitored, through observation, samples of work, photographs and input from parents and the children. Parents are welcome to look at their child’s record at any time.

pageCache.pageTitle: Upper School in Battersea, Clapham Junction - Ages 7-11 | Dolphin School
pageCache.text:
Ages 7-11
Welcome to the Upper School. As Dolphin pupils progress from the Lower School, they move up towards the next phase in their education. Prep aged children (Years 3-6) progress through a robust, 11+ focused curriculum. Pupils not only have the security of having their own inspiring class teachers but they also enjoy the expertise and passion of subject specialists in Art, Music, Drama, PE and Spanish.
We aim to keep our class sizes small. In that way, we are able to understand each child’s unique potential.This, combined with our unique pastoral approach, allows each Dolphin pupil to be known and loved, and therefore, to thrive!
It is not only the way in which we implement the core curriculum that we are proud of, but also in the cherished values that pervade the school day. All of our children benefit from an all-inclusive approach to sport, music and productions. Each child has the opportunity to represent their school, in each of those disciplines, regardless of ability.
Our modern approach to learning beautifully balances innovative teaching methods with traditional techniques while infusing the learning with up-to-date technology.
Love Wisdom Truth Come & Visit Us
OUR NEXT OPEN MORNING – THURSDAY 8 OCTOBER 2026
As a leading prep school in Battersea, Dolphin School offers a distinctive and nurturing educational experience that combines academic excellence with a strong sense of community. Located just moments from Clapham Junction, we provide a supportive environment where children are encouraged to grow in confidence, curiosity, and independence. Our approach balances a rich, well-rounded curriculum with a focus on individual development, ensuring every pupil is prepared not only for the next stage of their education, but for life beyond the classroom.
Join us on 8 October at 09:15 for Dolphin School’s Open Morning and experience our small school with remarkable outcomes!
